name: AI_GUARD_CONFIG
label: Guard configuration (JSON)
help: The district, its funding pools (including the safety pool), model rates, Hall Monitor profiles per audience, and, unless the district app is bound as SCHOOLOS_DISTRICT, its directory snapshot, workspaces and confirmed Workshop user links. See packages/schoolos-ai-guard/README.md for the schema.

name: HALL_MONITOR_URL
label: Hall Monitor URL
help: The HTTPS origin of the Hall Monitor deployment this district's moderation runs on.

name: HALL_MONITOR_ISSUER
label: Service token issuer
help: The iss claim of the guard's service tokens. Hall Monitor must list it in HM_TRUSTED_ISSUERS with the signing key's public half.

name: HALL_MONITOR_SIGNING_KEY
label: Service token signing key
help: A private Ed25519 or P-256 JSON Web Key (with a kid) the guard signs its Hall Monitor service tokens with.
